title: Migration map -- a host's signed statement of what becomes of its prior agent system (ADR-011)
description: HOST data. `prior` declares the BOUNDARY of the prior system: every path at or below a listed root is in the census, and nothing else is -- no path is found by resemblance. Each row answers the paths at or below its `path` with one disposition from the kit's declared succession vocabulary, carrying exactly the fields that disposition declares; the most specific row answers a path. A path no row answers is undecided, never defaulted. The map is a declaration: it moves nothing. Seeded BLANK at its residence (ADR-012): no prior root, no row and no signer -- a map in which nobody has declared anything. `declared_by` and `declared_at` are the signature; a map with rows and no signature is read, and is never carried out.
